newsitem.title: USA: Premier Parks begins shr, debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Premier Parks begins shr, debt offer.

text.p: Premier Parks Inc said on Tuesday it has commenced a public offering of six million shares of its common stock and $125 million of notes.
The public offering price for the stock was $29.00 a share, raising $165.6 million in net proceeds to the company without the exercise of 900,000 shares to cover overallotments, Premier Parks said.
Premier Parks said its $125 million of 9-3/4 percent senior notes due 2007 was priced at 100 percent of par and net proceeds to the company will be $121.25 million.
Lehman Brothers was the lead manager of both offerings, Premier Parks said.
Smith Barney and Furman Selz acted as co-managers of the stock offering, while Chase Securities, Smith Barney and Furman Selz are acting as co-managers of the note offering, Premier Parks said.
Proceeds from the offerings will be used to make acquisitions of additional theme parks, expand existing parks and refinance existing indebtedness, chief financial officer James Dannhauser said.
Prior to the offering, the company had 11.4 million fully diluted shares, Dannhauser said.
